incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: HIGH - service="inference-api" symptom="p99_latency>5s" SLO_burn=4.2%

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident INC12345 — page sent to #eng-oncall (urgent)

A.J.: acked and joining bridge, pulling dashboards.
A.J.: initial check — p95 up modestly, p99 spike across eu-west and us-east.
Maria G.: seeing KV-cache evictions and increased backend cpu on model-sidecars. timeline looks ~10:27 UTC start.
Kevin T.: autopager suppression rule "noisy-alert-suppress-v2" suppressed 3 alerts at 10:28, reason: threshold flapping guard.
A.J.: that suppression delayed PD escalation by ~90s — we should note impact.
Sophia L.: are customers impacted? any 5xxs?
Maria G.: 5xxs are flat, but user latencies affect chat timeouts. Top metric: chat_session_drop_rate +0.4% correlated.
A.J.: estimated customer-impact: ~0.6% of active sessions saw >5s token latency, mostly multi-turn chat. ops severity: medium-high.

ops-bot: Running recommended runbook steps: 
1) scale dedicated inference pool by +20%
2) force KV-cache sticky routing for recent prefixes
3) temporarily disable noisy-alert-suppress-v2

A.J.: executing step 1 now — scaling dedicated pool (cmd: `infra scale-pool inference-dedicated --add 2`)
Maria G.: applying sticky routing patch to reduce cross-eviction noise, patch queued.
Kevin T.: disabling suppression rule TTL=10m to avoid missing follow-ups.

A.J.: dashboards show p99 dropping slowly after scale started, from ~6.2s -> 4.8s in first 60s.
Sophia L.: good — keep monitoring. can someone run a flamegraph on sidecar CPU to see kernel stalls?
Maria G.: grabbing `perf` on one noisy host, uploading snippet.

A.J.: note for incident log: autopager suppression caused a gap in PD escalations. we need to triage suppression logic postmortem. tagging as PD-issue.
Kevin T.: adding a temporary fallback: if SLO_burn>3% for >3m, force immediate PD page regardless of suppression. rolling patch to alerting.

Sophia L.: taking ownership for the handoff — I'll stay on for next 2 hours to stabilize and own customer comms if needed.
A.J.: thanks — I've documented mitigation steps and the commands run. passing the bridge.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: INC12345 acknowledged by A.J.; assigned to Sophia L. for ongoing triage.

Sophia L.: next actions:
- watch p99 and chat drop rate for 30m window
- run regression checks against canary prompts (eval set id=chat_smoke_v2)
- post an update to #customer-success if we see >1% session drops
- open postmortem ticket for suppression gating (assign Kevin)

Maria G.: saving logs and traces to S3 at s3://redwood-ops/incidents/INC12345/ for investigators.

Sophia L.: ETA 30m for stable. will update PD notes and close if p99 <3.5s and SLO burn <1% over 30m.

A.J.: thanks team. quick note: include the autoscaler config hash used (autoscaler:v3.4.1) in postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident INC12345 status: Mitigated -> Monitoring.

Sophia L.: handoff complete — I have the bridge and will keep PD updated.

-- end of thread --
